newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London edge up in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London edge up in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London were generally dormant on Wednesday, with a slight bounce by Nomura Securities Co Ltd the main feature, dealers said.
By 1505 GMT the Nikkei 50 index was at 1,449.22, up 13.51 points or 0.94 percent from Tuesday's London close. In Tokyo, the Nikkei closed 32.84 points or 0.18 percent higher at 18,472.45.
Nomura shares were trading around 1385 yen, up from a Tokyo close of 1370.
Nomura shares fell in Tokyo after the company was raided by Japanese prosecutors investigating suspected illegal payments to corporate racketeers.
Analysts here said the scandal surrounding Nomura would force it to lie low for a while but the firm was bound to rise to the top again eventually.
Otherwise, the market was quiet. "There seems to be a pre-Easter, end-of-financial-year lethargy," one dealer said.
